description: Locate and parse the Renovate configuration in a repository. Searches, in Renovate's own priority order, for renovate.json(|c|5), .github/renovate.json(|c|5), .gitlab/renovate.json(|c|5), .renovaterc, .renovaterc.json(|c|5), and finally the 'renovate' field of package.json.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

name: read_config
title: Read Renovate config
